commandRunner_comment: `bun test src`, like the other packages: mutation runs in a sandbox: a copy
of this package alone, instrumented sources, a moved cwd. A test that depends
on anything but the mutated code fails there and nowhere else.
thresholds_comment: Measured 2026-09-05, every mutator but BlockStatement: 63.70% (293 killed,
0 timeouts, 167 survived, 0 uncovered). 1,667 tests cover every line and a
third of the mutations still survive; the weakest is no-global-jsx-namespace
(52.25%). `break` at 58 leaves ~5 points of slack, like the other packages.
It is a ratchet: when the score rises, this number rises with it.
